marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure Investment
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology leaders reported ongoing capital expenditure growth dedicated to AI data centers, while core cloud division revenues expanded over 20% year-over-year.
marketLayer.inference: Continued high CapEx spending sustains strong order visibility for upstream semiconductor vendors and network equipment providers, backing growth valuations in the US tech sector.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of software-level AI monetization and potential corporate margin pressure if cloud spending momentum cools.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & China Internet Capital Return Programs
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index components showed steady net inflows, bolstered by large-scale daily share repurchases from major platform operators including Tencent and Meituan through Southbound Stock Connect.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced shareholder yield through buybacks and dividends establishes a valuation floor for leading Chinese internet firms, drawing long-term institutional allocation.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of broader domestic consumer spending recovery and competition dynamics within local life services.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & US Yield Curve
marketLayer.fact: US inflation indicators matched forecasts, maintaining market-implied probabilities for a 25 bps interest rate reduction at the upcoming FOMC meeting above 80% while 10-year Treasury yields settled around 4.15%.
marketLayer.inference: Stabilizing treasury yields reduce discount-rate volatility for growth equities, easing capital cost pressure across high-duration equity sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming labor market prints or unexpected energy cost spikes threatening inflation convergence.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Banking & Real Estate Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rates (HIBOR) trended slightly lower across key short-term tenors, while primary residential property sales showed localized volume pick-up following promotional pricing.
marketLayer.inference: Easing liquidity pressures mitigate funding costs for local property developers and banks, though margin compression remains a consideration for financial sector earnings.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistence of high USD/HKD interest rate differentials and real estate transaction momentum continuity.
